contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy coin. Nummus, possibly of Constantine II (317-340), possibly Trier mint, an aberrant version of a Gloria Exercitus issue of 330-335, Reece period 17. Obverse description: Bust probably right; a Janiform appearance if the coin is inverted might arise from double strike or overstriking. Obverse inscription: probably CONSTANTINVS NOB C.
